page.layout: One page of text: a table in two blocks side by side (left block with columns Cap., Verf., Loc., Th.; right block with columns Cap., Vers., partly cut off), with a capitalised heading across the top. Ghost print from the other side is not transcribed.; One page of a table of Scripture references in four to five columns (Loc., Th., Cap., Verf., Loc.), with a centred sub-heading near the foot of the table. The top of the page carries the running title above the columns.; One block: a table of numbers in two columns on the right part of the page, the left column cut off by the scan edge. The last line, "A D)", stands below the table.
page.notes: The right block is cut off at the right edge, so its Vers. column and the rest of its numbers are incomplete. The heading "AD GA..." is partly obscured by show-through; the letters shown are uncertain. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is left out. Some Cap. numerals in the left block are not fully legible and are copied as they appear. The leftmost columns and the right-hand column are cut at the scan edge; the right-hand figures are partly unreadable and read approximately, with [?] where uncertain. Far-left fragments of a first column are not transcribed. The footer mark "OOO 3" is left out, as this part continues below. The left column of this table is cut off by the scan edge, so only the last digits of its entries remain; the left-hand cells are given as far as they show. The header "Th." is the right-hand column heading.
